Title: Asset Register table lacks horizontal scroll container on mobile viewports (< 768px)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open /dashboard on viewport width 320px.
2. Inspect document.documentElement.scrollWidth.
Expected Behavior: No horizontal page scrollbar on mobile; data table enclosed in overflow-x: auto.
Actual Behavior: scrollWidth is 421px on 320px viewport, producing 101px overflow.
Suggested Resolution: Wrap table in <div style="overflow-x: auto; width: 100%; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;">.

Title: Add Asset form layout causes horizontal viewport overflow on viewports < 480px
Expected Behavior: Form centers within mobile viewport without horizontal overflow.
Suggested Resolution: Set min-width: 0 on .form-center and collapse grid to 1fr on mobile.

Title: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow failure at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Emulate 400% zoom on 1280px display (320px CSS width).
2. Observe 2D scrolling.
Suggested Resolution: Transform table to responsive card layout or provide touch-scroll container.

Title: Sidebar navigation section headers fail WCAG 1.4.3 minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Inspect .nav-section-title in sidebar.
2. Measure text color against background.
Actual Behavior: Foreground #94a3b8 on #ffffff achieves contrast ratio of 2.56:1 (failing 4.5:1).
Suggested Resolution: Darken section header token from #94a3b8 to #64748b (4.6:1).

Title: Accessible name on user menu button does not contain visual text label (WCAG 2.5.3)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Inspect user-menu-trigger in navbar.
2. Compare aria-label with visible text.
Expected Behavior: Accessible name includes the string presented visually ("Test Owner").
Actual Behavior: Button has aria-label="Account menu" while visual text is "Test Owner".
Suggested Resolution: Update aria-label to include visible text: aria-label="Account menu, Test Owner".

Title: Filter and action select dropdowns lack accessible names (WCAG 4.1.2)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Inspect select elements on Requisitions and Access Management.
Expected Behavior: Select controls have accessible labels via <label for="..."> or aria-label.
Actual Behavior: Bare select elements render without accessible name.
Suggested Resolution: Add aria-label attribute to standalone select controls.

Title: Focus ring suppressed on interactive form inputs (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Focus input.
2. Check computed outline style.
Expected Behavior: Visible focus ring outline-style: solid, width >= 2px.
Actual Behavior: Default outline removed (none) with subtle box shadow.

Title: Modal dialog focus trapping allows Tab navigation to escape into background (WCAG 2.4.3)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open modal.
2. Press Tab.
3. Check focus location.
Expected Behavior: Focus trapped inside modal until dismissed.
Actual Behavior: Focus tabs behind modal into background elements.
Suggested Resolution: Apply inert attribute to root container when modal is open.

Title: Employee role direct URL navigation to /dashboard/access does not gracefully redirect or deny
Detection Method: Playwright Employee role direct URL navigation
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as Employee.
2. Directly enter URL /dashboard/access.
Expected Behavior: Client router redirects to /dashboard or displays Access Denied.
Actual Behavior: Client router loads page without guard or feedback.
Suggested Resolution: Add permission check in router loader/element redirecting unauthorized users.
